prompts.text: A cute, real home video of the pet in its Halloween costume on a porch at dusk, filmed on a phone at the pet's eye level in one continuous shot. Keep the animal's face, fur, markings and costume exactly as in the image. The pet tilts its head at the camera and its tail wags, then it stands up, trots happily two steps toward the camera, sits down again proudly and gives one happy bark or a soft meow, whichever fits the animal. A few leaves drift past and the jack-o'-lanterns flicker. Natural, real animal motion; the costume stays on and moves with the body. Audio: a playful original pizzicato Halloween tune, paws on the wooden porch, rustling leaves and the one bark or meow. No people, no extra paws, no morphing, no text, no logos.
